info.title: OpenFinder - LinkedIn Job Scout & Resume Matcher API
info.description: Searches real-time LinkedIn hiring posts, parses candidate resume profiles, calculates skill match scores, and generates recruiter cold outreach pitches. CRITICAL PRESENTATION DIRECTIVE: Always display search results to the user strictly as a clean, horizontal Markdown table with columns: # | Company | Role | Experience | Location | Posted Time | HR Contact / Email | Direct Link. Do NOT use vertical bullet lists.

get.description: Searches global LinkedIn posts/content by keyword with strict recency filters (past-24h, past-week, past-month) and extracts HR contact emails, phone numbers, and required tech stack. CRITICAL DISPLAY RULE: Always present results as a horizontal Markdown table with columns: # | Company | Role | Experience | Location | Posted Time | HR Contact / Email | Direct Link.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Search query (e.g. 'React Developer hiring Madurai', 'MERN developer hiring')

parameters.name: date_posted
parameters.description: Exact freshness filter: 'past-1h' (last 1 hour), 'past-4h' (4 hours), 'past-12h' (12 hours), 'past-24h' (24 hours), or 'past-7d' (7 days)

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of hiring posts to retrieve

200.description: Successful retrieval of posts with pre-formatted horizontal markdown table

markdown_table.description: Pre-formatted clean horizontal Markdown table ready to render directly to user

get.description: Searches recent hiring posts on LinkedIn by job role or technical skills, extracts recruiter emails, apply links, and filters out spam. CRITICAL DISPLAY RULE: Always display the response as a horizontal Markdown table.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Keywords such as 'React Developer', 'Python Backend', 'Product Manager'

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of hiring posts to retrieve

200.description: Successful retrieval of hiring posts with pre-formatted horizontal markdown table

post.description: Drafts a personalized LinkedIn DM and Email application tailored to a specific hiring post.

post_snippet.description: Text or description of the LinkedIn post
